title: Ciphered Language Modeling: Fine-Tuning on Unknown Encrypted Script
description_md:
## Ciphered Language Modeling

Fine-tune a language model on provided ciphered text of an unknown synthetic language. The task tests understanding of subword tokenization, character-level n-gram statistics, and masked language model pre-training dynamics without access to standard pre-trained vocabularies.
editorial_md: Top solutions built specialized Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizers and trained lightweight RoBERTa architectures from scratch.
